audience: nonprofits and fundraising teams that use CharityFundraiser for donations and contacts

useCases.title: Review donations received in a period
useCases.text: List donations, newest first, with amount, currency, donor and payment status. Use a since time to pull only new donations.

useCases.title: Find a donor by name, email or tier
useCases.text: Search contacts by name or email, or filter them by donor tier, such as Major, Mid, Grassroots, Lapsed or Prospect.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact by email
useCases.text: Create a contact, or update the one with the same email. Tags merge with existing tags, and the same data twice changes nothing.

useCases.title: Review events and payment transactions
useCases.text: List the events, such as auctions and galas. List the payment transactions for donations, event tickets and point-of-sale sales.
